questions.title: Guest checkout
questions.question: What should happen to guest checkout?
questions.context: The two research docs contradict each other. The build cannot start until one wins.

detail.text: 41% of completed purchases in the test cohort came through guest checkout; removing it risks the largest single drop-off point we measured.
Guest orders are unreachable for lifecycle marketing; every guest checkout is a customer we cannot retain.
Picking an option decides the flow for this release only; the loyalty program question returns next quarter either way.

options: Keep it, but ask for account creation after payment

followups.title: Earlier guest orders
followups.question: What happens to orders placed as a guest before the change?
options: Link them to new accounts by email

questions.title: Launch payment providers
questions.question: Which payment providers should the store launch with?
questions.context: Fees and coverage differ; each card sums up one route, and the full comparison is in the popup.

blocks.text: Integration effort is roughly equal for all three per the platform team's estimate from the kickoff. Contract terms are annual for PayB, monthly for the other two.

options.label: PayA only
options.text: 2.9% plus 0.30 a payment, settled in 2 days, and it covers every region.

options.label: PayB only
options.text: 2.2% flat on an annual contract, settled in 7 days, but regional only.

options.label: PayA plus PayB, regional routing
options.text: PayB where it covers the region, PayA everywhere else. Two contracts to manage.

questions.title: Checkout button copy
questions.question: Which of these button lines are ready to ship?
questions.context: One shared answer per line; the pen adds a comment on any line. The full screen flow these appear in is linked below.

detail.text: Unanswered rows export as still open. Rework plus a comment means the comment gets applied and the line comes back for a re-approve.

items.label: Payment page: Pay now
items.note: Legal asked for the total amount to appear on or next to this button

items.label: Confirmation page: Order placed, track it here
Payment failure: Something went wrong, try again
items.note: Support flags this line weekly as too vague

questions.title: Error message tone
questions.question: What tone should the error messages take across the flow?
questions.context: Skip is disabled here: the copywriter is blocked until this lands. If none of the candidates fit, type the direction.
options: Plain and technical: state the error, state the fix
Warm and apologetic: soften first, then the fix
Route to the brand voice owner
